svg.text: Episode 14 pilot — is the pipeline producing anything sane?

Realized yaw moment against distance, computed downstream from each trajectory's own logged per-wheel forces (rule 7) — the same physics regardless of which controller chose them. NOT a result: this is a production run.
Did each variant learn anything at all?
finished=True distance=393 m peak 0.97 g util 0.44
Pilot run: this checks whether the infrastructure produces a sane trajectory and a D6 verdict for each variant, not whether either variant has
learned something worth reporting. A pilot policy that has not converged is expected to fail D6 and to produce a noisy or flat Mz trace — that is
what a short run looks like, not evidence about the research question.
[MEASURED] realized Mz from logged per-wheel forces via DoubleTrackBackend.yaw_moment · RUNG 2, PILOT — not a result (rule 15)
Classical C's line (if present) is Episode 13's DEMANDED moment, not realized — H and E have no separate demand for E, so all three are shown as what the wheels actually did.
